display_name: Records: key dates due within 90 days
query_text: SELECT urgency, date_format(key_date, 'd MMM yyyy') AS due, days_left, date_type, subject, team, file_name FROM document_intelligence.gold.key_dates WHERE urgency IN ('Overdue', 'Within 30 days', 'Within 90 days') ORDER BY key_date
